descriptionInUI: Runtime for the fleet's finite anti-ship missiles. Inert unless the mission generator emits dcsRetribution.navalMagazines (the 'Stagger naval weapons release' or 'Cross-turn naval magazines' setting is on and a naval group exists). With the stagger on, warships spawn on ReturnFire and are released to weapons-free one group at a time across a window, so a modern fleet -- whose missiles out-range the whole theatre -- develops the exchange instead of emptying its tubes in the opening minute; ReturnFire, never weapons-hold, so a ship still defends itself while it waits. With magazines on, every anti-ship missile actually fired is counted against that group's campaign stock, a group that runs dry drops back to ReturnFire (winchester, not disarmed), and the expenditure is reported so the turn boundary can debit the persisted magazine -- there is no rearm. The land-attack weapons the cruise-missile plugin meters are excluded, so the two magazines never charge the same shot. Sets ROE and counts real weapon releases only: no spawns, no kills.
